capabilities: Rename attachments using an MD5 hash of their content
Update links in notes after renaming attachments
Delete duplicate files with identical content in the same folder
Restrict processing by attachment type, ignored folders, or linked files only
extras: The README warns that 'Rename all attachments' only works with standard markdown links (not wikilinks) and recommends backing up files before running it; detailed output goes to the developer console.
problem: Obsidian attachments can end up with duplicate or non-unique names, making it hard to tell whether two files are copies and cluttering the vault.

relations.evidence: You might want to use this plugin in conjunction with Consistent attachments and links plugin.

summary: Attachment renamer that gives files unique names generated from an MD5 hash of their content and updates the links that point to them.
